description:
Load and display the full content of the oldest soul inscription from a Taproot address.

Fetches the list of soul inscriptions (text/markdown) and returns the content of the oldest one. If no address is provided, uses the current wallet's Taproot address.

Returns: inscription metadata and full Markdown content.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Taproot (bc1p...) address to query. Omit to use the current wallet's Taproot address.

name: souldinals_load_soul
